standard_prerequisites.name: A finite locally free morphism is flat and finite, a finite morphism is proper, and finite local freeness is preserved by base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, labels morphisms-lemma-finite-flat (proof line 2454), morphisms-lemma-finite-proper (proof line 2456) and morphisms-lemma-base-change-finite-locally-free (proof line 2463)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the properness and flatness assertions and shows that the base change of the morphism over an integral closed subscheme is again finite locally free of the same degree.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cycle class of a closed subscheme, flat pullback and proper pushforward of cycle classes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-pullback-coherent (proof line 2470) and lemma-cycle-push-sheaf (proof line 2470)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the formula for an integral class to the statement that the pushforward of the pulled back structure sheaf is a finite locally free sheaf of the given rank, giving the factor d.

core_obligations: Record properness and flatness from the cited statements and note that the formula makes sense (proof lines 2452-2458).
Reduce to an integral class: it suffices to prove the formula for the class of an integral closed subscheme of the relevant dimension (proof lines 2459-2461).

Conclude by base change: over that subscheme the morphism is again finite locally free of degree d, so the pushforward of the pulled back structure sheaf is finite locally free of rank d, and the cycle class computation gives the factor d using flat pullback and proper pushforward of cycle classes (proof lines 2461-2471).
proof_roadmap: Properness, flatness and the reduction (proof lines 2452-2461).
Base change of finite local freeness to the component (proof lines 2461-2464).
Cycle class computation giving the factor d (proof lines 2464-2471).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite locally free morphism of degree d the composite of pushforward with pullback is multiplication by d on cycle classes, and that such a morphism is proper and flat of relative dimension zero (statement lines 2438-2450, tag 02R4-adjacent). The proof records properness and flatness, reduces to the class of an integral closed subscheme, observes that the base change over it is again finite locally free of degree d, and computes the cycle class of the pushed forward structure sheaf. The degree computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
